title: Enoki Omelet Patties
description: Little enoki mushroom patties are made with green onions, carrots, and eggs and are ready in minutes for a quick and easy omelet-style side dish.
ingredients: 2 (3 ounce) packages enoki mushrooms, coarsely chopped
1 small carrot, peeled and very finely chopped
2 pinches ground white pepper, or to taste
1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed

steps.text: Mix mushrooms, green onion, and carrot together in a large bowl. Add eggs to mushroom mixture; stir until well combined. Season with white pepper; mix well.

Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Spoon about 2 tablespoons egg mixture for each patty into hot oil. Press patties lightly with the back of a spatula. Cook until bottom of patty is solid enough to flip, about 50 seconds. Flip and cook other side is lightly browned, 10 to 15 seconds. Repeat with remaining egg mixture.
